# systeam_escalation_policy (Resource)

Manages an escalation policy with ordered steps.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the escalation policy.
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this policy belongs to.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the escalation policy is active.
- `step` (Attributes List) Ordered escalation steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--step))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the escalation policy.

<a id="nestedatt--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `step_order` (Number) Order of this step in the escalation chain (1-based).
- `target_type` (String) Type of escalation target: user, schedule, or channel.

Optional:

- `delay_minutes` (Number) Delay in minutes before escalating to this step.
- `target_channel_id` (Number) ID of the target notification channel (when target_type is 'channel').
- `target_schedule_id` (Number) ID of the target on-call schedule (when target_type is 'schedule').
- `target_user_id` (Number) ID of the target user (when target_type is 'user').
